404_410.description: Requires 3 consecutive failures before public card suppression

runbook.step_1: Scheduled runner triggers every 4 hours with fixed 30 Mall SKU IDs from 03_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH/j387/sku_registry.json.
runbook.step_2: Each probe queries health worker using exact itemId via TLS IP-pinned connection; arbitrary URL inputs are strictly rejected.
runbook.step_3: HTTP response code is mapped to conservative state machine. Observations are recorded in immutable audit log schema.
runbook.step_4: If an item records 3 consecutive 404/410 failures, card suppression state is toggled to true and an alert is emitted to on-call within <=60s.
runbook.step_5: If item returns 200 on subsequent sweep, suppression is cleared automatically.
runbook.step_6: No 100% uptime claims; public UI displays transparent observation timestamps.
